A miss is a shape where the chosen candidate is not the fastest measured; regret = chosen time / fastest time (1.0 = optimal); gain over always-scan = scan time / chosen time. The fitted coefficients come from the training shapes only; the held-out shapes are evaluated, never fitted.
Times are native calls of the entry points the registry names (no Python formatting); costs are relative work units. CUDA candidates are planned and executed only with --device.
